value.0: From afar, a solitary figure in tattered robes appears as a mere traveler. It closes the distance with unnatural speed, lashing out with rusted blades to butcher any who stand in its path.

She glides with a lethal, predatory grace, her movements as fluid as water. This undead elf wields a blade of ancient craft to carve through armor and bone alike, meeting the most valiant champions with effortless lethality.
The tabletop of this magnificently built round table has finely inlaid patterns using several types of wood, making it a prized furnishing for anyone with an eye for decor.

An oven, or something that was one once. The mouth of it is cold, and has been cold a long time, and the brick around it is scored with four grooves that run in from the corners and meet in the middle like the spokes of a broken wheel. One groove for each of the watches that shut this place.

Nothing in it burns any more. Something in it still counts.
